messages.subject: Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) plot
parts:
Hi,

I am performing a Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) and plot the results using ggplot2 (Example script below).

I would like to know is it possible to add to the plot a marker that indicates each group centroid and from it draw spikes to each group element? My desired plot is better shown in the attached link (http://i.stack.imgur.com/Cna3R.png) which is based on the adegenet package.

Thanks a lot.


Example:
library(MASS)   
require(ggplot2)

Raw <- read.csv(url("http://archive.ics.uci.edu/ml/machine-learning-databases/wine/wine.data"),header=FALSE)
raw.lda<-lda(V1 ~ V2+V3+V4+V5+V6+V7+V8+V9+V10+V11+V12+V13+V14, data = Raw)
LD1<-predict(raw.lda)$x[,1]
LD2<-predict(raw.lda)$x[,2]
ggplot(Raw, aes(x=LD1, y=LD2, col=Raw$V1))+ geom_point(aes(color = Raw$V1)) + theme_bw()
